name: Mekakure Kanojo no Netorare Bouken Kiroku
original_name: メカクレ彼女の寝取られ冒険記録
source:
Lovers Thor and Mimi are on a trip together,
when Thor confesses that he gets hard imagining her sleeping with other men.
To fulfill his desires, Mimi enters a dungeon full of men.
